law_record.title: Commercial vehicles, recreational vehicles and trailers (A)
law_record.text: Except as otherwise provided in this Section or as permitted by posted sign, it is unlawful for a person to stand, park or store, upon any street adjacent to a residence district, public school or public park, a commercial vehicle, recreational vehicle, trailer, or any combination of vehicle and trailer having an overall length of twenty-four feet or more or an unladen weight in excess of eight thousand pounds. For purposes of the preceding sentence, a "residence district" means the territory contiguous to a street, not comprising a business district, in which the parcels abutting such street for a distance of three hundred feet or more are mainly occupied by dwellings or by dwellings and buildings in use for residence. The provisions of Subsection (A) do not apply to a commercial vehicle that is: (1) Parked in front of property from which or to which goods or passengers are being picked up or delivered, but only for that period of time during which goods or passengers are being expeditiously loaded or unloaded; or (2) Being used in conjunction with the performance of service, repair, construction or similar essential use within the immediate neighborhood.

exceptions: where a posted sign permits it

unladen weight is not observable; overall length is, through kin.extent
